headlines.title: 1 Third US carrier joins Iran blockade, Bessent warns of economic collapse
headlines.snippet: A third US aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East Sunday, joining forces enforcing a blockade of Iranian ports, while Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned of a historic economic collapse in Iran, predicting a 25 percent contraction over the coming year.
headlines.snippet_he: נושאת מטוסים אמריקאית שלישית הגיעה למזרח התיכון ביום ראשון, והצטרפה לכוחות שאכפו מצור על נמלים איראניים, בעוד שר האוצר סקוט בסנט הזהיר מפני קריסה כלכלית היסטורית באיראן, וחזה התכווצות של 25 אחוזים בשנה הקרובה.

headlines.title: 2 Iran facing one of fastest economic collapses ever, Bessent says

headlines.title: 3 Blair's sister-in-law attended Iran conference linked to IRGC spy recruitment - Telegraph

headlines.title: 4 VOICES FROM IRAN Toxic air chokes Iranian cities, residents report health problems
headlines.snippet: Worsening air pollution across Iran has left citizens reporting headaches, nausea and breathing difficulties, with many criticizing authorities for keeping schools open, according to accounts received by Iran International.

headlines.title: 5 Petrol restrictions spark public anger, fears of rising prices in Iran
